entries.mechanism: UKMOD_PUBLIC_B2026.03 (system UK_2026) grants savings income a 0% band equal to the taxpayer's dividend income when both are present, zeroing income tax that the Income Tax Act 2007 sections 11D/12/12A charge on that savings at the savings basic/higher/additional rate. The savings starting rate (s.12) is reduced only by non-savings income, never by dividend income, so the source-grounded RuleSpec taxes the savings correctly. tin_s therefore falls short of the statutory liability by min(savings above the personal savings allowance, dividend income) times the marginal savings rate. Each residual below reconciles the UKMOD tin_s to the statutory RuleSpec liability by adding back that wrongly-zeroed savings tax.
